jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholarship Program in Space and Astro-Informatics
jobs.description:
(*The deadline has been extended to May 12th*) (*People interested in
   applying with Prof. Ido Ben-Dayan should also notify about their
   application by a direct email to idobd@ariel.ac.il *) Ariel University
   (AU) invites excellent candidates to apply for a unique Postdoctoral
   Scholarship Program in Space and Astro-Informatics, which will enhance
   academic cooperation through international scientific collaborations.
   The core research themes integrate faculty members from multiple
   departments across the university and from a broad range of
   disciplines, including astrophysics, cosmology, remote sensing (from
   space and toward space), as well as other research areas that
   integrate space, either as the subject of study or as a research
   platform, with big data. These data may originate from large-scale
   observational surveys or be generated through advanced numerical and
   computational simulations. Further information about faculty members,
   research activities, achievements, and publications is available on
   the Center’s website: https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/agas For more
   information about Ariel University:
   https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/au-international/ Compensation and Benefits
   Compensation Type Salary Currency 467 Compensation Range $38,000USD to
   $40,000USD Included Benefits Ariel University will award Postdoctoral
   scholarships of 120,000 NIS per year for up to two years. In addition,
   postdoctoral fellows in the program will be eligible for conference
   travel funding of up to USD 1,200 to support presentation at
   international conference(s), subject to prior approval and
   reimbursement based on actual expenses and the applicable exchange
   rates. Fellows must apply to the AU authorities to receive this
   additional funding. Compensation Notes The compensation is in the form
   of a scholarship rather than a salary. Application Details Application
   Instructions
   https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/agas/2026/02/11/outstanding-postdoctoral-researchers-in-space-and-astro-informatics-2026/
   Link to Online Application
   https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/agas/wp-content/uploads/sites/309/2026/02/Call-for-A��
   Publication Start Date 2026 Mar 15 Application Deadline 2026 May 12

jobs.title: Postdoc position in Cosmology and Theoretical High Energy Physics
jobs.description:
We are looking for postdocs! The Physics Department of Ariel University (https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/physics/en/)
   invites applications for Postdoc position in Cosmology and Theoretical
   High Energy Physics broadly defined in the research group of Prof. Ido
   Ben-Dayan. Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree in Physics or
   Astronomy, and should have research experience in at least one of the
   topics. The postdoc employment will be for 2 years, with a possible
   extension to a third year, contingent on funding and productivity The
   annual salary is set by a predetermined matrix from the University.
   The postdoc will join the efforts of the research group and can also
   pursue his own research. To apply, please send a short CV (maximum 2
   pages), a list of publications and a cover letter (1 page) to the
   academicjobsonline system, as well as 3 letters of recommendation
   uploaded directly by the letter writers. Selected candidates will be
   asked to send additional documents, as detailed in
   https://www.ariel.ac.il/wp/postdocs/apply/required-documents/. The
   position is open until filled.
